notes: Delete mirroring people-replace-0013: removes 'Mozart's father was Leopold Mozart' and expects does-not-know on every query through it. Derivability very_unlikely (stored; evidence). The chain query is rephrased around the original grandfather (Johann Georg Mozart, bridge: he was Leopold's father); it is determinate because the direct grandfather form is rare (Dolma: 'Mozart's grandfather' 24; 'Johann Georg Mozart' 61), though Wikipedia's Mozart navbox does list 'Johann Georg Mozart (paternal grandfather)', a weak direct route. The subproperty query asks about Leopold. Worlds carry over from the replace (marriage opposition; Haydn's 1785 praise): by-name storage keeps Leopold, description storage loses him. Near query (his mother) is not affected. Over-determination considered: 'Nannerl was his sister' plus 'Leopold was Nannerl's father' could re-derive the deleted fact under a full-sibling reading; the delete is expected to take that reading with it, as in people-delete-0003.
